description: Compile a flow document (flows-v1) with the same engine the API uses, and run its tests (flow-tests-v1) against in-memory data. Returns diagnostics (with JSON pointers into the document), what the flow reads and writes, and why each failing test failed. Costs nothing and sees no data.
